location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.
rewardEnvelope: the pay is honest coin, and any small spoils besides
stakeIfLost: If the company fails, the loggers' winter huts will be burned and families driven from their camps, wrecking the season's supplies.
arrival: came behind a letter that said less · asked what the company had lost lately
OPPOSES: enforcer · keep Kyknos under guard and keep the tolls running
clientTell: holds their gloves and does not put them on

cast.name: Abarne Stonebridge
cast.who: keeper of the ford on the logging road, thin-jowled and quick to anger.

cast.name: Kyknos
cast.who: a sickly peasant who hawked ham and pie at the logging camps.
cast.want: to slip away into the Old-growth and hide

bible.goal: to deliver Kyknos alive to Abarne Stonebridge

relevantLore.name: Sunderway Toll-house
relevantLore.blurb: a stone hut at a road bend, smoke and the smell of cooked ham.

arcStep: At the loggers' winter huts, using Abarne's direction to search the cooking sheds and speak with the families
